source: GEO GSE264667, GSE264667_hepg2_raw_singlecell_01.h5ad (Nadig et al. 2025, Nat Genet)
source_note: scperteval hosted copy (nadig25hepg2) is a requester-pays GCS object and stores log-normalized X only; the GEO raw single-cell file is used instead and contains raw counts.
perturbation_column: obs['gene'] (gene symbol); obs['gene_id'] provides Ensembl IDs

expression_scale.X: normalize_total(target_sum=1e4) then log1p (official GEARS convention), float32 sparse CSR
expression_scale.layers['counts']: raw integer counts, float32 sparse CSR

gene_panel.method: scanpy highly_variable_genes, n_top_genes=5000, computed on working subset log1p X
gene_panel.var_names: Ensembl gene IDs; var['gene_name'] holds symbols

additional_qc: none beyond the authors' processed release (documented decision)
